channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Ultra Raises $50 Million Series A for Warehouse Robots, Deepens Physical Intelligence Partnership
item.description: The round brings announced funding to $62 million including seed capital, as Ultra scales its warehouse robot service and work with Physical Intelligence.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: BYD Humanoid Robot Design Emerges in Patent Images
item.description: Patent images reported by CnEVPost offer a look at BYD’s proposed humanoid, while a formal unveiling and technical specifications remain pending.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ARC Brings Human-Piloted Humanoid Fights to Singapore
item.description: Professional fighters piloted Unitree G1 and EngineAI T800 robots at ARC’s Singapore event, as REK and UFB pursue their own robot entertainment formats.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dyna Robotics’ Taku to Join Nasdaq Closing Bell at RoboStrategy Event
item.description: The October 13 event will bring robotics executives and robot demonstrations to New York ahead of a Nasdaq closing-bell appearance.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From X to San Francisco: Devang Adhyaru Brings Humanoid Hub Together
item.description: Ahead of the October 15–16 Humanoid Hub Conference, Devang Adhyaru discusses bringing robotics offline, the promise of robot hands, and the road to useful home humanoids.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Aether AI Unveils CRIS-0, a Robot AI System That Checks Its Own Actions
item.description: In a written interview, Aether explains how CRIS-0 combines causal prediction with action verification, and why generalization remains its biggest challenge.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Patent Application Details Flexible Touch Sensors for Robot Hands
item.description: The filing describes curved tactile sensor arrays and ways to manufacture them, offering a likely glimpse into Optimus development without confirming their use in its new hand.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen Expand Humanoid Robot Partnership Into Factory Logistics
item.description: The companies will develop and test logistics applications, building on Walker S Lite quality-inspection trials at FAW-Volkswagen’s Qingdao plant.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: REK Adds Swords to Humanoid Robot Fights With “Deathmatch”
item.description: Humanoid boxing was apparently just the warm-up. REK’s October 9 Deathmatch adds blade-equipped robots and a Rektile-versus-T-REK main event.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Faraday Future’s “Built in USA” Robot Plan Starts With Assembly—and Sourced Hardware
item.description: FF targets U.S. robot production in February 2027, while its current catalog points to Booster and AGIBOT platforms. Here is what its localization plan establishes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Mecka Raises $60M Series B to Expand Robot Training Data and Deployment
item.description: The Sequoia-led round includes Nvidia and Microsoft’s M12 as Mecka expands human-demonstration data collection and commercial robot deployment.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Nvidia Has Discussed Another $1 Billion Investment in Figure, The Information Reports
item.description: The reported talks come as Figure pursues its multibillion-dollar Nscale compute agreement and Index training-data project. No completed deal has been established.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Names Former Amazon AI Leader Rohit Prasad as CEO
item.description: Prasad takes over on October 7, bringing experience leading Alexa and Amazon Nova as Boston Dynamics advances its AI and commercialization plans.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility's Investor Day: Digit 5 Launches at a $150,000 Bill of Materials, and Its $300M Order Unlocks Skill by Skill
item.description: At its Analyst & Investor Day, Agility put Digit 5's launch bill of materials at about $150,000, above Digit 4's, for RaaS product margins near 50% until production reaches 1,000 units a year. Executives said the $300 million, 1,000-robot order releases robots in tranches as Digit 5 proves specific use cases, described general availability as end of 2027 and early 2028, and said the leased fleet will be funded with debt.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Deep Robotics Tests IP66-Rated DR02 on Traffic Duty in the Rain
item.description: A new video shows DR02 testing traffic reminders and pedestrian interaction in Hangzhou, highlighting the humanoid’s claimed all-weather protection.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Our Latest Newsletter: The Minerva Interview, Atlas Hands and More
item.description: Our October 6 briefing brings together our Minerva interview, Atlas’s new hands, Galbot pricing and more. Read the edition and subscribe for free.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Minerva Emerges From Stealth With $10M for Humanoids Built for Dangerous Work
item.description: The startup is developing Roger for hazardous energy and public safety work. CEO Sandor Felber explains why a human operator remains central to its approach.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Meta Job Listing Explicitly References Its Humanoid Robot Hardware
item.description: A Redmond engineering role describes failure analysis, assembly improvements and ongoing support for Meta’s humanoid hardware, adding detail to its previously reported robotics program.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Donut Robotics Secures ¥300 Million Charm Care Alliance for Eldercare Humanoids
item.description: Charm Care will invest ¥300 million in Donut Robotics as the companies trial cinnamon in a nursing home and develop future nurse-call support.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility Hosts Analyst & Investor Day Today, With Digit 5 and Scaling Plans in Focus
item.description: Agility will outline its technology and business plans in a webcast beginning at 12:30 p.m. ET, ahead of its proposed public listing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility CEO Peggy Johnson Joins Project Meridian, Bringing Humanoid Logistics Expertise to Defense Study
item.description: Johnson will advise MITRE’s future-warfare study in an individual capacity, highlighting humanoid logistics applications. Project Meridian’s co-directors include Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Kawasaki Plans Noetra-Powered Kaleido Rollout Around 2030, With Autonomy Expanding in Stages
item.description: Kaleido is the first planned adopter of Noetra’s physical AI, Nikkei reports. Kawasaki envisions initial patrol and transport tasks, with remote control and AI giving way to broader autonomy.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Panasonic Targets Humanoid Robot Production by 2029, Citing Battery Safety
item.description: Panasonic plans humanoids for factories and warehouses, with a new AI and robotics R&D division leading development and battery safety presented as a potential advantage.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GPT-6 Astra Leads SuperCLUE’s Robot-Brain Benchmark, With a Wide Planning Advantage
item.description: GPT-6 Astra scores highest among ten models in SuperCLUE’s September evaluation, with a 21.42-point lead in interaction and planning over Gemini-3.8-Flash.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RoboParty Unveils RP1 Humanoid at IROS, Plans Broader Open-Source Release in Q4
item.description: RoboParty’s RP1 debuted with balance-recovery demonstrations at IROS. The developer-focused humanoid builds on ROBOTO ORIGIN, with broader hardware and software releases planned for Q4.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Optimus Plant Takes Shape in Texas, With Steel Structure Estimated at 40%
item.description: Joe Tegtmeyer’s latest Giga Texas update details advancing steelwork and upper-floor concrete at the Optimus factory, with substantial construction still ahead.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Galbot Prices ET1 Humanoid From 79,000 Yuan Across Three Versions
item.description: Galbot’s ET1 starts at 79,000 yuan, with Pro and Flagship versions adding compute and advertised learning capabilities at higher prices.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Musk Says Tesla Halved AI5 RAM to Secure Memory for Optimus Production
item.description: Tesla cut AI5 memory to 72GB and AI6 to 144GB, Musk says, citing Optimus supply needs and lower costs while keeping bandwidth unchanged.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Clone Shows Torso 3 Hand Demo, Targets November Launch for Redesigned Torso 4
item.description: Clone’s teleoperated hand demo shows its legacy design, while the company says a redesigned Torso 4 will target stationary two-arm enterprise tasks in November.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Nucleus Shares Nearly Two Hours of Factory Work, Says Demo Is 60% Autonomous
item.description: CEO Melvin Schwarz tells Humanoids Daily the demo is 60% autonomous and 40% teleoperated, as Nucleus reports regular four-to-six-hour factory shifts.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
